title: Roof replacement
shortDesc: Tear-off and a new roof system after we see the deck.
fullDesc: When shingles are done, another coat of patches will not hold. {{name}} replaces roofs in {{city}} and {{region}} with a written scope before work starts.
heading: When replacement is the honest call
body: Soft decking, curled shingles, or repeated leaks mean the system is finished. We say that on the inspection instead of selling another repair.

faq.q: How long does a replacement take?
faq.a: Most homes are a few days once materials are on site. Weather sets the start.

title: Roof repair
shortDesc: Leaks, flashing, and missing shingles scoped to the actual damage.
fullDesc: {{name}} repairs roofs in {{region}} when the rest of the system still has life. You see the leak path and the fix before we start.
heading: Repair when the roof still has life
body: A stained ceiling can be one flashing joint. We check that before quoting a full replacement.

faq.q: Can you repair just the leak?
faq.a: Yes, when the surrounding roof is sound. If the field is failing, we will say replacement is the better spend.

title: Storm damage
shortDesc: Wind and hail damage documented before repairs begin.
fullDesc: After a storm, {{name}} inspects {{city}} roofs, photographs what we find, and explains repair versus replacement.
heading: Document first
body: We do not guess from the ground. The inspection notes what the storm did and what was already worn.

faq.a: We document the roof and meet you on site. Your carrier still decides the claim.

title: Gutters
shortDesc: Gutters and downspouts that move water off the roof and away from the foundation.
fullDesc: {{name}} installs and repairs gutters in {{region}} so water does not sit at the fascia or the basement wall.
heading: Water has to leave the house
body: A new roof still fails at the edge if gutters overflow into the soffit. We look at both.

faq.q: Do you replace gutters with the roof?
faq.a: When the troughs are crushed, leaking, or pitched wrong, we include them in the estimate.

title: Roof inspections
shortDesc: A walk of the roof with notes you can act on.
fullDesc: {{name}} inspects roofs in {{city}} for buyers, sellers, and owners who want to know what is left before a storm season.
highlights: No pressure to book the same day
heading: Know the roof before you spend
body: You get plain language: what is leaking, what is aging, and what can wait.

faq.a: Estimates for repair or replacement include the look. A standalone inspection for a sale is quoted up front. Call {{phone}}.
